description: CHPROV needs the AuthInfo: without RPP-Authorization the proxy sends nothing.

setup.comment: Creates request contact RG10 with uriTemplate; expects 201 01000. The General Request contact of the domain below.
Creates request contact RA10 with uriTemplate; expects 201 01000. The Abuse contact of the domain below.
Creates request contact RG10 of registrar b with uriTemplate as registrar b; expects 201 01000. The General Request contact of the domain below.
Creates request contact RA10 of registrar b with uriTemplate as registrar b; expects 201 01000. The Abuse contact of the domain below.
Creates contact XT3; expects 201 01000. The registrant of the domain below.
Creates domain x3 with registrant XT3, generalRequest, abuse, dns records a, authInfo; expects 201 01000. The domain the steps below work on.
Creates contact XT3 of registrar b as registrar b; expects 201 01000. The registrant of the domain below.

steps.comment: Requests a transfer of domain x3 with registrant, generalRequest, abuse, dns as registrar b; expects 400 02003. The error answer this case checks.

teardown.comment: Deletes domain x3; expects 200. MTEST keeps what a case creates, so the case deletes it.
